design_brief.aesthetic: Editorial assessment workbook with compact operational controls, confident emerald surfaces, warm orange highlights from the supplied mark, crisp dividers, and restrained motion.
design_brief.colors: Deep forest #0B3D2E, leaf green #167052, mist #F2F6F2, white #FFFFFF, ink #14231B, and signal orange #F26A00.
design_brief.hero_element: The next required assessment step and its live completion progress, with the report locked or revealed directly beneath it.
design_brief.moment: A candidate opens the app on a phone after work, completes a real capability assessment, invites raters, and immediately understands the score trail while an administrator can inspect the same record end to end.
design_brief.typography: Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Public Sans for body and controls.
